text_simplified: This text discusses the importance of self-directed learning and self-discipline. It points out that a person must begin with themselves in improving behavior before advising others. It also clarifies that true wisdom lies in applying what we learn to ourselves first.

review_defects.arabic: الحكمة تكون في تطبيق ما نتعلمه على أنفسنا أولاً
review_defects.english: true wisdom lies in applying what we learn to ourselves first
review_defects.why: The English adds 'true' which is not in the Arabic; the Arabic simply says 'wisdom is in...' without the qualifier 'true'.
